name: qa-toolkit
description: Helps a QA build fast, robust understanding of a project's basics (summary, architecture, data flow, automation requirements, testing strategy, rollout plan), review pull requests from a testing-risk lens (what changed, what's untested, what's fragile), generate prioritized manual/automated test plans by reading the docs those two skills produce, and build a full project-wide test case inventory by reading across all onboarding docs. Supports depth (junior/mid/senior) and framing (visual/trace/risk) modifiers, passed as arguments to any of the four skills.
